verdict.rationale: Framer is a SaaS website builder, so data-retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy-posture question. The evidence only shows that agents can delete CMS content items and that version history is saved automatically. Those are content-editing features, not controls over how long user or AI data is kept or how it is deleted, and no retention policy, account or data deletion, or AI-data handling settings are documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
